Leaked Slack shows OpenAI staff pushed Brockman off $25 million PAC pledge

Semafor says leaked Slack messages show OpenAI employees pressed Greg Brockman in June over his super PAC ties, and that he dropped $25 million of a $50 million pledge.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-semafor-brockman-slack/

Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri-1, a 78B open-weights model with 3.5B active

The German lab's Apache 2.0 model reads 262,144 tokens, was trained on 20 trillion tokens of English, German and code, and its card says it runs on two 80GB A100 or H100 GPUs.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-aleph-alpha-kolibri-1/

The Verge says OpenAI's Dots agents feel like workplace software

The Verge's hands-on says OpenAI's cartoon Dots feel like work tools that also order a burrito, while one commentator says launch hype hurt, and Meta's rival Muse tops app stores.
